name: ComplexEventCreditEventCurrency
description: Specifies the applicable currency when ComplexEventCreditEventValue(40999) is an amount. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

name: ComplexEventCreditEventPeriod
description: Time unit multiplier for complex credit events.

name: ComplexEventCreditEventUnit
description: Time unit associated with complex credit events.

name: ComplexEventCreditEventDayType
description: Specifies the day type for the complex credit events.

name: ComplexEventCreditEventRateSource
description:
Identifies the source of rate information used for credit events.
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/credit-event-rate-source for code list of applicable sources.

name: NoComplexEventCreditEventQualifiers
description: The number of qualifiers in the repeating group.

name: ComplexEventCreditEventQualifier
description: Specifies a complex event qualifier. Used to further qualify ComplexEventCreditEventType(40998).

name: NoComplexEventPeriodDateTimes
description: The number of entries in the date-time repeating group.

name: ComplexEventPeriodDate
description: The averaging date for an Asian option.

name: ComplexEventPeriodTime
description: The averaging time for an Asian option.

name: NoComplexEventPeriods
description: The number of periods in the repeating group.

name: ComplexEventPeriodType
description: Specifies the period type.

name: ComplexEventBusinessCenter
description:
The business center used to determine dates and times in the schedule or date-time group.
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

name: NoComplexEventRateSources
description: The number of rate sources in the repeating group.

name: ComplexEventRateSource
description: Identifies the source of rate information.

name: ComplexEventRateSourceType
description: Indicates whether the rate source specified is a primary or secondary source.

name: ComplexEventReferencePage
description:
Identifies the reference page from the rate source.
For FX, the reference page to the spot rate is to be used for the reference FX spot rate.
When ComplexEventRateSource(41014) = 3 (ISDA Settlement Rate Option) this contains the value from the scheme that reflects the terms of the Annex A to the ISDA 1998 FX and Currency Option Definitions. See: https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/settlement-rate-option.

name: ComplexEventReferencePageHeading
description: Identifies the reference page heading from the rate source.

name: NoComplexEventDateBusinessCenters
description: The number of business centers in the repeating group.

name: ComplexEventDateBusinessCenter
description:
The business center calendar used to adjust the complex event date, e.g. "GBLO".
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

name: ComplexEventDateUnadjusted
description: The unadjusted complex event date.

name: ComplexEventDateRelativeTo
description:
Specifies the anchor date when the complex event date is relative to an anchor date.
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

name: ComplexEventDateOffsetPeriod
description: Time unit multiplier for the relative date offset.

name: ComplexEventDateOffsetUnit
description: Time unit associated with the relative date offset.

name: ComplexEventDateOffsetDayType
description: Specifies the day type of the relative date offset.

name: ComplexEventDateBusinessDayConvention
description: The business day convention used to adjust the complex event date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the DateAdjustment component within the Instrument component.

name: ComplexEventDateAdjusted
description: The adjusted complex event date.

name: ComplexEventFixingTime
description: The local market fixing time.

name: ComplexEventFixingTimeBusinessCenter
description:
The business center calendar used to determine the actual fixing times.
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

name: NoComplexEventCreditEventSources
description: Number of event sources in the repeating group.

name: ComplexEventCreditEventSource
description: A newspaper or electronic news service that may publish relevant information used in the determination of whether or not a credit event has occurred.

name: NoComplexEventSchedules
description: Number of schedules in the repeating group.

name: ComplexEventScheduleStartDate
description: The start date of the schedule.

name: ComplexEventScheduleEndDate
description: The end date of the schedule.

name: ComplexEventScheduleFrequencyPeriod
description: Time unit multiplier for the schedule date frequency.

name: ComplexEventScheduleFrequencyUnit
description: Time unit associated with the schedule date frequency.

name: ComplexEventScheduleRollConvention
description: The convention for determining the sequence of dates. It is used in conjunction with a specified frequency. Used only to override the roll convention defined in the DateAdjustment component in Instrument.

name: NoDeliverySchedules
description: Number of delivery schedules in the repeating group.

name: DeliveryScheduleType
description: Specifies the type of delivery schedule.

name: DeliveryScheduleXID
description: Identifier for this instance of delivery schedule for cross referencing elsewhere in the message.

name: DeliveryScheduleNotional
description: Physical delivery quantity.

name: DeliveryScheduleNotionalUnitOfMeasure
description: Specifies the delivery quantity unit of measure (UOM).

values.meaning: Principal with relation to debt instrument

name: DeliveryScheduleNotionalCommodityFrequency
description: The frequency of notional delivery.

name: DeliveryScheduleNegativeTolerance
description: Specifies the negative tolerance value. The value may be an absolute quantity or a percentage, as specified in DeliveryScheduleToleranceType(41046). Percentage value is to be expressed relative to "1.0" representing 100% (e.g. a value of "0.0575" represents 5.75%).

name: DeliverySchedulePositiveTolerance
description: Specifies the positive tolerance value. The value may be an absolute quantity or a percentage, as specified in DeliveryScheduleToleranceType(41046). Value may exceed agreed upon value. Percentage value is to be expressed relative to "1.0" representing 100% (e.g. a value of "0.0575" represents 5.75%).

name: DeliveryScheduleToleranceUnitOfMeasure
description: Specifies the tolerance value's unit of measure (UOM).

values.meaning: Principal with relation to debt instrument

name: DeliveryScheduleToleranceType
description: Specifies the tolerance value type.

name: DeliveryScheduleSettlCountry
description: Specifies the country where delivery takes place. Uses ISO 3166 2-character country code.

name: DeliveryScheduleSettlTimeZone
description:
Delivery timezone specified as "prevailing" rather than "standard" or "daylight".
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/prevailing-timezones for code list of applicable prevailing timezones.

name: DeliveryScheduleSettlFlowType
description: Specifies the commodity delivery flow type.

name: DeliveryScheduleSettlHolidaysProcessingInstruction
description: Indicates whether holidays are included in the settlement periods. Required for electricity contracts.

name: NoDeliveryScheduleSettlDays
description: Number of delivery schedules in the repeating group.

name: DeliveryScheduleSettlDay
description: Specifies the day or group of days for delivery.

name: DeliveryScheduleSettlTotalHours
description: The sum of the total hours specified in the DeliveryScheduleSettlTimeGrp component.

name: NoDeliveryScheduleSettlTimes
description: Number of hour ranges in the repeating group.

name: DeliveryScheduleSettlStart
description: The scheduled start time for the delivery of the commodity where delivery occurs over specified times. The format of the time value is specified in DeliveryScheduleSettlTimeType(41057).

name: DeliveryScheduleSettlEnd
description: The scheduled end time for the delivery of the commodity where delivery occurs over specified times. The format of the time value is specified in DeliveryScheduleSettlTimeType(41057).

name: DeliveryScheduleSettlTimeType
description: Specifies the format of the delivery start and end time values.

name: DeliveryStreamType
description: Specifies the type of delivery stream.

name: DeliveryStreamPipeline
description: The name of the oil delivery pipeline.

name: DeliveryStreamEntryPoint
description: The point at which the commodity will enter the delivery mechanism or pipeline.

name: DeliveryStreamWithdrawalPoint
description: The point at which the commodity product will be withdrawn prior to delivery.

name: DeliveryStreamDeliveryPoint
description:
The point at which the commodity product will be delivered and received. Value specified should follow market convention appropriate for the commodity product.
For bullion, see https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/bullion-delivery-location for values.

name: DeliveryStreamDeliveryRestriction
description: Specifies under what conditions the buyer and seller should be excused of their delivery obligations.

name: DeliveryStreamDeliveryContingency
description:
Specifies the electricity delivery contingency.
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/electricity-transmission-contingency for values.

name: DeliveryStreamDeliveryContingentPartySide
description: The trade side value of the party responsible for electricity delivery contingency.

name: DeliveryStreamDeliverAtSourceIndicator
description: When this element is specified and set to 'Y', delivery of the coal product is to be at its source.

name: DeliveryStreamRiskApportionment
description:
Specifies how the parties to the trade apportion responsibility for the delivery of the commodity product.
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/risk-apportionment for the details of the external code list.

name: DeliveryStreamTitleTransferLocation
description: Specifies the title transfer location.

name: DeliveryStreamTitleTransferCondition
description: Specifies the condition of title transfer.

values.meaning: Does not transfer with risk of loss

name: DeliveryStreamImporterOfRecord
description: A party, not necessarily of the trade, who is the Importer of Record for the purposes of paying customs duties and applicable taxes or costs related to importation.

name: DeliveryStreamNegativeTolerance
description: Specifies the negative tolerance value. The value may be an absolute quantity or a percentage, as specified in DeliveryStreamToleranceType(41074). Percentage value is to be expressed relative to "1.0" representing 100% (e.g. a value of "0.0575" represents 5.75%).

name: DeliveryStreamPositiveTolerance
description: Specifies the positive tolerance value. The value may be an absolute quantity or a percentage, as specified in DeliveryStreamToleranceType(41074). Value may exceed agreed upon value. Percentage value is to be expressed relative to "1.0" representing 100% (e.g. a value of "0.0575" represents 5.75%).

name: DeliveryStreamToleranceUnitOfMeasure
description: Specifies the tolerance value's unit of measure (UOM).

values.meaning: Principal with relation to debt instrument

name: DeliveryStreamToleranceType
description: Specifies the tolerance value type.

name: DeliveryStreamToleranceOptionSide
description: Indicates whether the tolerance is at the seller's or buyer's option.

name: DeliveryStreamTotalPositiveTolerance
description: The positive percent tolerance which applies to the total quantity delivered over all shipment periods.

name: DeliveryStreamTotalNegativeTolerance
description: The negative percent tolerance which applies to the total quantity delivered over all shipment periods.

name: DeliveryStreamNotionalConversionFactor
description: If the notional quantity is specified in a unit that does not match the unit in which the commodity reference price is quoted, the scaling or conversion factor used to convert the commodity reference price unit into the notional quantity unit should be stated here. If there is no conversion, this field is not intended to be used.

name: DeliveryStreamTransportEquipment
description: The transportation equipment with which the commodity product will be delivered and received.

name: DeliveryStreamElectingPartySide
description: A reference to the party able to choose whether the gas is delivered for a particular period as found in a swing or interruptible contract.

name: NoDeliveryStreamCycles
description: Number of delivery cycles in the repeating group.

name: DeliveryStreamCycleDesc
description: The delivery cycles during which the oil product will be transported in the pipeline.

name: EncodedDeliveryStreamCycleDescLen
description: Byte length of encoded (non-ASCII characters) EncodedDeliveryStreamCycleDesc(41084) field.

name: EncodedDeliveryStreamCycleDesc
description: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the DeliveryStreamCycleDesc(41082) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding (347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the DeliveryStreamCycleDesc(41082) field.

name: NoDeliveryStreamCommoditySources
description: Number of commodity sources in the repeating group.

name: DeliveryStreamCommoditySource
description:
The SCoTA coal cargo origin, mining region, mine(s), mining complex(es), loadout(s) or river dock(s) or other point(s) of origin that seller and buyer agree are acceptable origins for the coal product. For international coal transactions, this is the origin of the coal product.
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/commodity-coal-product-source for values.

name: MarketDisruptionProvision
description: The consequences of market disruption events.

name: MarketDisruptionFallbackProvision
description: Specifies the location of the fallback provision documentation.

name: MarketDisruptionMaximumDays
description: Specifies the maximum number of market disruption days (commodity or bullion business days) in a contract or confirmation. If none are specified, the maximum number of market disruption days is five (5).

name: MarketDisruptionMaterialityPercentage
description: Used when a price materiality percentage applies to the price source disruption event and this event has been specified.

name: MarketDisruptionMinimumFuturesContracts
description: Specifies the minimum futures contracts level that dictates whether or not a 'De Minimis Trading' event has occurred.

name: NoMarketDisruptionEvents
description: Number of disruption events in the repeating group.

name: MarketDisruptionEvent
description:
Specifies the market disruption event.
For commodities see https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/commodity-market-disruption for values.
For foreign exchange, see https://fixtrading.org/packages/market-disruption-event for code list of applicable event types.

name: NoMarketDisruptionFallbacks
description: Number of fallbacks in the repeating group.

name: MarketDisruptionFallbackType
description:
Specifies the type of disruption fallback.
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/commodity-market-disruption-fallback for values.

name: NoMarketDisruptionFallbackReferencePrices
description: Number of fallback reference securities in the repeating group.

name: MarketDisruptionFallbackUnderlierType
description: The type of reference price underlier.

name: MarketDisruptionFallbackUnderlierSecurityID
description: Specifies the identifier value of the security.

name: MarketDisruptionFallbackUnderlierSecurityIDSource
description: Specifies the class or source scheme of the security identifier.

values.meaning: Consolidated Tape Association (CTA) Symbol (SIAC CTS/CQS line format)

name: MarketDisruptionFallbackUnderlierSecurityDesc
description: Specifies the description of the underlying security.

name: EncodedMarketDisruptionFallbackUnderlierSecurityDescLen
description: Byte length of encoded (non-ASCII characters) EncodedMarketDisruptionFallbackUnderlierSecurityDesc(41102) field.

name: EncodedMarketDisruptionFallbackUnderlierSecurityDesc
description: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the MarketDisruptionFallbackUnderlierSecurityDesc(41100) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding (347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the MarketDisruptionFallbackUnderlierSecurityDesc(41100) field.

name: MarketDisruptionFallbackOpenUnits
description: If there are multiple underlying assets, this specifies the number of units (index or securities) that constitute the underlier of the swap. In the case of a basket swap, this is used to reference both the number of basket units, and the number of each asset components of the basket when these are expressed in absolute terms.

name: MarketDisruptionFallbackBasketCurrency
description: Specifies the currency if the underlier is a basket. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

name: MarketDisruptionFallbackBasketDivisor
description: Specifies the basket divisor amount. This value is normally used to adjust the constituent weight for pricing or to adjust for dividends, or other corporate actions.

name: ExerciseDesc
description: A description of the option exercise.

name: EncodedExerciseDescLen
description: Byte length of encoded (non-ASCII characters) EncodedExerciseDesc(41102) field.

name: EncodedExerciseDesc
description: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the ExerciseDesc(41106) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding (347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the ExerciseDesc(41106) field.

name: AutomaticExerciseIndicator
description: Indicates (when 'Y') that exercise is automatic when the strike price is crossed or the underlying trade is in the money.

name: AutomaticExerciseThresholdRate
description: The threshold rate for triggering automatic exercise.

name: ExerciseConfirmationMethod
description: Indicates whether follow-up confirmation of exercise (written or electronic) is required following telephonic notice by the buyer to the seller or seller's agent.

name: ManualNoticeBusinessCenter
description:
Identifies the business center used for adjusting the time for manual exercise notice.
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

name: FallbackExerciseIndicator
description: Indicates whether the notional amount of the underlying swap, not previously exercised under the option, will be automatically exercised at the expiration time on the expiration date if at such time the buyer is in-the-money, provided that the difference between the settlement rate and the fixed rate under the relevant underlying swap is not less than one tenth of a percentage point (0.10% or 0.001).

name: LimitedRightToConfirmIndicator
description: Indicates whether the Seller may request the Buyer to confirm its intent to exercise if not done on or before the expiration time on the expiration date. If true ("Y") specific rules will apply in relation to the settlement mode.

name: ExerciseSplitTicketIndicator
description: Indicates in physical settlement of bond and convertible bond options whether the party required to deliver the bonds will divide those to be delivered as notifying party desires to facilitate delivery obligations.

name: NoOptionExerciseBusinessCenters
description: Number of business centers in the repeating group.

name: OptionExerciseBusinessCenter
description:
The business center calendar used to adjust the option exercise dates, e.g. "GBLO".
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

name: OptionExerciseBusinessDayConvention
description: The business day convention used to adjust the option exercise dates. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the DateAdjustment component within the Instrument component.

name: OptionExerciseEarliestDateOffsetDayType
description: Specifies the day type of the relative earliest option exercise date offset.

name: OptionExerciseEarliestDateOffsetPeriod
description: Time unit multiplier for the relative earliest exercise date offset.

name: OptionExerciseEarliestDateOffsetUnit
description: Time unit associated with the relative earliest exercise date offset.

name: OptionExerciseFrequencyPeriod
description: Time unit multiplier for the frequency of exercise dates.

name: OptionExerciseFrequencyUnit
description: Time unit associated with the frequency of exercise dates.

name: OptionExerciseStartDateUnadjusted
description: The unadjusted start date for calculating periodic exercise dates.

name: OptionExerciseStartDateRelativeTo
description:
Specifies the anchor date when the option exercise start date is relative to an anchor date.
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

name: OptionExerciseStartDateOffsetPeriod
description: Time unit multiplier for the relative exercise start date offset.

name: OptionExerciseStartDateOffsetUnit
description: Time unit associated with the relative exercise start date offset.

name: OptionExerciseStartDateOffsetDayType
description: Specifies the day type of the relative option exercise start date offset.

name: OptionExerciseStartDateAdjusted
description: The adjusted start date for calculating periodic exercise dates.

name: OptionExerciseSkip
description: The number of periods in the referenced date schedule that are between each date in the relative date schedule. Thus a skip of 2 would mean that dates are relative to every second date in the referenced schedule. If present this should have a value greater than 1.

name: OptionExerciseNominationDeadline
description: Last date (adjusted) for establishing the option exercise terms.

name: OptionExerciseFirstDateUnadjusted
description: The unadjusted first exercise date.

name: OptionExerciseLastDateUnadjusted
description: The unadjusted last exercise date.

name: OptionExerciseEarliestTime
description: The earliest time at which notice of exercise can be given by the buyer to the seller (or seller's agent) (i) on the expriation date, in the case of a European style option, (ii) on each Bermuda option exercise date and the expiration date, in the case of a Bermuda style option, (iii) the commencement date to, and including, the expiration date, in the case of an American option.

name: OptionExerciseLatestTime
description: The latest exercise time. See also OptionExerciseEarliestTime(41134).

name: OptionExerciseTimeBusinessCenter
description:
The business center used to determine the locale for option exercise time, e.g. "GBLO".
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values

name: NoOptionExerciseDates
description: Number of dates in the repeating group.

name: OptionExerciseDate
description: The option exercise fixed date, unadjusted or adjusted depending on OptionExerciseDateType(41139).

name: OptionExerciseDateType
description: Specifies the type of date. When specified it applies not only to the current date but to all subsequent dates in the group until overridden with a new type.

name: NoOptionExerciseExpirationDateBusinessCenters
description: Number of business centers in the repeating group.

name: OptionExerciseExpirationDateBusinessCenter
description:
The business center calendar used to adjust the option exercise expiration dates, e.g. "GBLO".
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

name: OptionExerciseExpirationDateBusinessDayConvention
description: The business day convention used to adjust the option exercise expiration dates. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the DateAdjustment component within the Instrument component.

name: OptionExerciseExpirationDateRelativeTo
description:
Specifies the anchor date when the option exercise expiration date is relative to an anchor date.
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

name: OptionExerciseExpirationDateOffsetPeriod
description: Time unit multiplier for the relative exercise expiration date offset.

name: OptionExerciseExpirationDateOffsetUnit
description: Time unit associated with the relative exercise expiration date offset.

name: OptionExerciseExpirationFrequencyPeriod
description: Time unit multiplier for the frequency of exercise expiration dates.

name: OptionExerciseExpirationFrequencyUnit
description: Time unit associated with the frequency of exercise expiration dates.

name: OptionExerciseExpirationRollConvention
description: The convention for determining the sequence of exercise expiration dates. It is used in conjunction with a specified frequency. Used only to override the roll convention defined in the DateAdjustment component in Instrument.

name: NoOptionExerciseExpirationDates
description: Number of fixed exercise expiration dates in the repeating group.

name: OptionExerciseExpirationDate
description: An adjusted or unadjusted fixed option exercise expiration date.

name: OptionExerciseExpirationDateType
description: Specifies the type of option exercise expiration date. When specified it applies not only to the current date but to all subsequent dates in the group until overridden with a new type.

name: PaymentUnitOfMeasure
description: Used to express the unit of measure (UOM) of the payment amount if not in the currency of the trade.

name: PaymentDateRelativeTo
description:
Specifies the anchor date when the payment date is relative to an anchor date.
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

name: PaymentDateOffsetPeriod
description: Time unit multiplier for the relative payment date offset.

name: PaymentDateOffsetUnit
description: Time unit associated with the relative payment date offset.

name: PaymentDateOffsetDayType
description: Specifies the day type of the relative payment date offset.

name: PaymentForwardStartType
description: Forward start premium type.

name: NoPaymentScheduleFixingDays
description: Number of fixing days in the repeating group.

name: PaymentScheduleFixingDayOfWeek
description: The day of the week on which fixing will take place.

values.meaning: Every day (the default if not specified)

name: PaymentScheduleFixingDayNumber
description: The occurrence of the day of week on which fixing takes place.

name: PaymentScheduleXID
description: Identifier of this PaymentSchedule for cross referencing elsewhere in the message.

name: PaymentScheduleXIDRef
description: Reference to payment schedule elsewhere in the message.

description: The currency of the schedule rate. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

name: PaymentScheduleRateUnitOfMeasure
description: The schedule rate unit of measure (UOM).

name: PaymentScheduleRateSpreadType
description: Identifies whether the rate spread is an absolute value to be added to the index rate or a percentage of the index rate.

name: PaymentScheduleSettlPeriodPrice
description: The schedule settlement period price.

name: PaymentScheduleSettlPeriodPriceCurrency
description: Specifies the currency of the schedule settlement period price. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

name: PaymentScheduleSettlPeriodPriceUnitOfMeasure
description: The settlement period price unit of measure (UOM).

name: PaymentScheduleStepUnitOfMeasure
description: The schedule step unit of measure (UOM).

name: PaymentScheduleFixingDayDistribution

description: The number of days over which fixing should take place.

description: Time unit multiplier for the fixing lag duration.

description: Time unit associated with the fixing lag duration.

name: PaymentScheduleFixingFirstObservationDateOffsetPeriod
description: Time unit multiplier for the relative first observation date offset.

name: PaymentScheduleFixingFirstObservationDateOffsetUnit
description: Time unit associated with the relative first observation date offset.

name: PaymentStreamFlatRateIndicator
description: When this element is specified and set to 'Y', the Flat Rate is the New Worldwide Tanker Nominal Freight Scale for the Freight Index Route taken at the Trade Date of the transaction "Fixed". If 'N' it is taken on each Pricing Date "Floating".

name: PaymentStreamFlatRateAmount
description: Specifies the actual monetary value of the flat rate when PaymentStreamFlatRateIndicator(41180) = 'Y'.

name: PaymentStreamFlatRateCurrency
description: Specifies the currency of the actual flat rate. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

name: PaymentStreamMaximumPaymentAmount
description: Specifies the limit on the total payment amount.

name: PaymentStreamMaximumPaymentCurrency
description: Specifies the currency of total payment amount limit. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

name: PaymentStreamMaximumTransactionAmount
description: Specifies the limit on the payment amount that goes out in any particular calculation period.

name: PaymentStreamMaximumTransactionCurrency
description: Specifies the currency of the period payment amount limit. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

name: PaymentStreamFixedAmountUnitOfMeasure
description: Specifies the fixed payment amount unit of measure (UOM).

name: PaymentStreamTotalFixedAmount
description: Specifies the total fixed payment amount.

name: PaymentStreamWorldScaleRate
description: The number of Worldscale points for purposes of the calculation of a fixed amount for a wet voyage charter commodity swap.

name: PaymentStreamContractPrice
description: The price per relevant unit for purposes of the calculation of a fixed amount for a dry voyage charter or time charter commodity swap.

name: PaymentStreamContractPriceCurrency
description: Specifies the currency of PaymentStreamContractPrice(41190). Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

name: NoPaymentStreamPricingBusinessCenters
description: Number of business centers in the repeating group.

name: PaymentStreamPricingBusinessCenter
description:
The business center calendar used to adjust the payment stream's pricing dates, e.g. "GBLO".
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

name: PaymentStreamRateIndex2CurvePeriod
description: Secondary time unit multiplier for the payment stream's floating rate index curve.

name: PaymentStreamRateIndex2CurveUnit
description: Secondary time unit associated with the payment stream's floating rate index curve.

name: PaymentStreamRateIndexLocation
description: Specifies the location of the floating rate index.

name: PaymentStreamRateIndexLevel
description: This is the weather Cooling Degree Days (CDD), Heating Degree Days (HDD) or HDD index level specified as the number of (amount of) weather index units specified by the parties in the related confirmation.

name: PaymentStreamRateIndexUnitOfMeasure
description: The unit of measure (UOM) of the rate index level.

values.meaning: Principal with relation to debt instrument

name: PaymentStreamSettlLevel
description: Specifies how weather index units are to be calculated.

name: PaymentStreamReferenceLevel
description: This is the weather Cooling Degree Days (CDD), Heating Degree Days (HDD) or HDD reference level specified as the number of (amount of) weather index units specified by the parties in the related confirmation.

name: PaymentStreamReferenceLevelUnitOfMeasure
description: The unit of measure (UOM) of the rate reference level.

values.meaning: Principal with relation to debt instrument

name: PaymentStreamReferenceLevelEqualsZeroIndicator
description: When set to 'Y', it indicates the weather reference level equals zero.

name: PaymentStreamRateSpreadCurrency
description: Specifies the currency of the floating rate spread. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

name: PaymentStreamRateSpreadUnitOfMeasure
description: Species the unit of measure (UOM) of the floating rate spread.

name: PaymentStreamFinalRate
description: The floating rate determined at the final reset. The rate is expressed in decimal form, e.g. 5% is represented as 0.05.

description: Time unit multiplier for the calculation lag duration.

name: PaymentStreamCalculationLagUnit

name: LegDeliveryStreamType
description: Specifies the type of delivery stream.

name: LegDeliveryStreamPipeline
description: The name of the oil delivery pipeline.

name: LegDeliveryStreamEntryPoint
description: The point at which the commodity will enter the delivery mechanism or pipeline.

name: LegDeliveryStreamWithdrawalPoint
description: The point at which the commodity product will be withdrawn prior to delivery.

name: LegDeliveryStreamDeliveryPoint
description:
The point at which the commodity product will be delivered and received. Value specified should follow market convention appropriate for the commodity product.
For bullion, see https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/bullion-delivery-location for values.

name: LegDeliveryStreamDeliveryRestriction
description: Specifies under what conditions the buyer and seller should be excused of their delivery obligations.

name: LegDeliveryStreamDeliveryContingency
description:
Specifies the electricity delivery contingency. See
https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/electricity-transmission-contingency for values.

name: LegDeliveryStreamDeliveryContingentPartySide
description: The trade side value of the party responsible for electricity delivery contingency.

name: LegDeliveryStreamDeliverAtSourceIndicator
description: When this element is specified and set to 'Y', delivery of the coal product is to be at its source.

name: LegDeliveryStreamRiskApportionment
description:
Specifies how the parties to the trade apportion responsibility for the delivery of the commodity product.
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/risk-apportionment for the details of the external code list.

name: LegDeliveryStreamTitleTransferLocation
description: Specifies the title transfer location.

name: LegDeliveryStreamTitleTransferCondition
description: Specifies the condition of title transfer.

values.meaning: Does not transfer with risk of loss

name: LegDeliveryStreamImporterOfRecord
description: A party, not necessarily of the trade, who is the Importer of Record for the purposes of paying customs duties and applicable taxes or costs related to importation.

name: LegDeliveryStreamNegativeTolerance
description: Specifies the negative tolerance value. The value may be an absolute quantity or a percentage, as specified in LegDeliveryStreamToleranceType(41445). Percentage value is to be expressed relative to "1.0" representing 100% (e.g. a value of "0.0575" represents 5.75%).

name: LegDeliveryStreamPositiveTolerance
description: Specifies the positive tolerance value. The value may be an absolute quantity or a percentage, as specified in LegDeliveryStreamToleranceType(41445). Value may exceed agreed upon value. Percentage value is to be expressed relative to "1.0" representing 100% (e.g. a value of "0.0575" represents 5.75%).

name: LegDeliveryStreamToleranceUnitOfMeasure
description: Specifies the tolerance value's unit of measure (UOM).

values.meaning: Principal with relation to debt instrument

name: LegDeliveryStreamToleranceType
description: Specifies the tolerance value type.

name: LegDeliveryStreamToleranceOptionSide
description: Indicates whether the tolerance is at the seller's or buyer's option.

name: LegDeliveryStreamTotalPositiveTolerance
description: The positive percent tolerance which applies to the total quantity delivered over all shipment periods.

name: LegDeliveryStreamTotalNegativeTolerance
description: The negative percent tolerance which applies to the total quantity delivered over all shipment periods.

name: LegDeliveryStreamNotionalConversionFactor
description: If the notional quantity is specified in a unit that does not match the unit in which the commodity reference price is quoted, the scaling or conversion factor used to convert the commodity reference price unit into the notional quantity unit should be stated here. If there is no conversion, this field is not intended to be used.

name: LegDeliveryStreamTransportEquipment
description: The transportation equipment with which the commodity product will be delivered and received.

name: LegDeliveryStreamElectingPartySide
description: A reference to the party able to choose whether the gas is delivered for a particular period e.g. a swing or interruptible contract.

name: NoLegStreamAssetAttributes
description: Number of asset attribute entries in the group.

name: LegStreamAssetAttributeType
description:
Specifies the name of the attribute.
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/asset-attribute-type for code list of applicable asset attribute types.

name: LegStreamAssetAttributeValue
description: Specifies the value of the attribute.

name: LegStreamAssetAttributeLimit
description: Limit or lower acceptable value of the attribute.

name: NoLegDeliveryStreamCycles
description: Number of commodity sources in the repeating group.

name: LegDeliveryStreamCycleDesc
description: The delivery cycles during which the oil product will be transported in the pipeline.

name: EncodedLegDeliveryStreamCycleDescLen
description: Byte length of encoded (non-ASCII characters) EncodedLegDeliveryStreamCycleDesc(41459) field.

name: EncodedLegDeliveryStreamCycleDesc
description: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the LegDeliveryStreamCycleDesc(41457) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding (347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the LegLeg DeliveryStream(41457) field.

name: NoLegDeliveryStreamCommoditySources
description: Number of commodity sources in the repeating group.

name: LegDeliveryStreamCommoditySource
description:
The SCoTA coal cargo origin, mining region, mine(s), mining complex(es), loadout(s) or river dock(s) or other point(s) of origin that seller and buyer agree are acceptable origins for the coal product. For international coal transactions, this is the origin of the coal product.
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/commodity-coal-product-source for values.

name: LegMarketDisruptionProvision
description: The consequences of market disruption events.

name: LegMarketDisruptionFallbackProvision
description: Specifies the location of the fallback provision documentation.

name: LegMarketDisruptionMaximumDays
description: Specifies the maximum number of market disruption days (commodity or bullion business days) in a contract or confirmation. If none are specified, the maximum number of market disruption days is five (5).

name: LegMarketDisruptionMaterialityPercentage
description: Used when a price materiality percentage applies to the price source disruption event and this event has been specified.

name: LegMarketDisruptionMinimumFuturesContracts
description: Specifies the minimum futures contracts level that dictates whether or not a 'De Minimis Trading' event has occurred.

name: NoLegMarketDisruptionEvents
description: Number of disruption events in the repeating group.

name: LegMarketDisruptionEvent
description:
Specifies the market disruption event.
For commodities see https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/commodity-market-disruption for values.
For foreign exchange, see https://fixtrading.org/packages/market-disruption-event for code list of applicable event types.

name: NoLegMarketDisruptionFallbacks
description: Number of fallbacks in the repeating group.

name: LegMarketDisruptionFallbackType
description:
Specifies the type of disruption fallback.
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/commodity-market-disruption-fallback for values.

name: NoLegMarketDisruptionFallbackReferencePrices
description: Number of fallback reference securities in the repeating group.

name: LegMarketDisruptionFallbackUnderlierType
description: The type of reference price underlier.

name: LegMarketDisruptionFallbackUnderlierSecurityID
description: Specifies the identifier value of the security.

name: LegMarketDisruptionFallbackUnderlierSecurityIDSource
description: Specifies the class or source scheme of the security identifier.

values.meaning: Consolidated Tape Association (CTA) Symbol (SIAC CTS/CQS line format)

name: LegMarketDisruptionFallbackUnderlierSecurityDesc
description: Specifies the description of the underlying security.

name: EncodedLegMarketDisruptionFallbackUnderlierSecurityDescLen
description: Byte length of encoded (non-ASCII characters) EncodedLegMarketDisruptionFallbackUnderlierSecurityDesc (41477) field.

name: EncodedLegMarketDisruptionFallbackUnderlierSecurityDesc
description: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the LegMarketDisruptionFallbackUnderlierSecurityDesc(41475) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding (347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the LegMarketDisruptionFallbackUnderlierSecurityDesc(41475) field.

name: LegMarketDisruptionFallbackOpenUnits
description: If there are multiple underlying assets, this specifies the number of units (index or securities) that constitute the underlier of the swap. In the case of a basket swap, this is used to reference both the number of basket units, and the number of each asset components of the basket when these are expressed in absolute terms.

name: LegMarketDisruptionFallbackBasketCurrency
description: Specifies the currency if the underlier is a basket. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

name: LegMarketDisruptionFallbackBasketDivisor
description: Specifies the basket divisor amount. This value is normally used to adjust the constituent weight for pricing or to adjust for dividends, or other corporate actions.

name: LegExerciseDesc
description: A description of the option exercise.

name: EncodedLegExerciseDescLen
description: Byte length of encoded (non-ASCII characters) EncodedLegExerciseDesc(41483) field.

name: EncodedLegExerciseDesc
description: Encoded (non-ASCII characters) representation of the LegExerciseDesc(41481) field in the encoded format specified via the MessageEncoding (347) field. If used, the ASCII (English) representation should also be specified in the LegExerciseDesc(41481) field.

name: LegAutomaticExerciseIndicator
description: Indicates (when 'Y') that exercise is automatic when the strike price is crossed or the underlying trade is in the money.

name: LegAutomaticExerciseThresholdRate
description: The threshold rate for triggering automatic exercise.

name: LegExerciseConfirmationMethod
description: Indicates whether follow-up confirmation of exercise (written or electronic) is required following telephonic notice by the buyer to the seller or seller's agent.

name: LegManualNoticeBusinessCenter
description:
Identifies the business center used for adjusting the time for manual exercise notice.
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

name: LegFallbackExerciseIndicator
description: Indicates whether the notional amount of the underlying swap, not previously exercised under the option, will be automatically exercised at the expiration time on the expiration date if at such time the buyer is in-the-money, provided that the difference between the settlement rate and the fixed rate under the relevant underlying swap is not less than one tenth of a percentage point (0.10% or 0.001).

name: LegLimitRightToConfirmIndicator
description: Indicates whether the Seller may request the Buyer to confirm its intent to exercise if not done on or before the expiration time on the expiration date. If true ("Y") specific rules will apply in relation to the settlement mode.

name: LegExerciseSplitTicketIndicator
description: Indicates in physical settlement of bond and convertible bond options whether the party required to deliver the bonds will divide those to be delivered as notifying party desires to facilitate delivery obligations.

name: NoLegOptionExerciseBusinessCenters
description: Number of business centers in the repeating group.

name: LegOptionExerciseBusinessCenter
description:
The business center calendar used to adjust the option exercise dates, e.g. "GBLO".
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

name: LegOptionExerciseBusinessDayConvention
description: The business day convention used to adjust the option exercise dates. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the LegDateAdjustment component within the InstrumentLeg component.

name: LegOptionExerciseEarliestDateOffsetDayType
description: Specifies the day type of the relative earliest exercise date offset.

name: LegOptionExerciseEarliestDateOffsetPeriod
description: Time unit multiplier for the relative earliest exercise date offset.

name: LegOptionExerciseEarliestDateOffsetUnit
description: Time unit associated with the relative earliest exercise date offset.

name: LegOptionExerciseFrequencyPeriod
description: Time unit multiplier for the frequency of exercise dates.

name: LegOptionExerciseFrequencyUnit
description: Time unit associated with the frequency of exercise dates.

name: LegOptionExerciseStartDateUnadjusted
description: The unadjusted start date for calculating periodic exercise dates.

name: LegOptionExerciseStartDateRelativeTo
description:
Specifies the anchor date when the option exercise start date is relative to an anchor date.
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

name: LegOptionExerciseStartDateOffsetPeriod
description: Time unit multiplier for the relative exercise start date offset.

name: LegOptionExerciseStartDateOffsetUnit
description: Time unit associated with the relative exercise start date offset.

name: LegOptionExerciseStartDateOffsetDayType
description: Specifies the day type of the relative option exercise start date offset.

name: LegOptionExerciseStartDateAdjusted
description: The adjusted start date for calculating periodic exercise dates.

name: LegOptionExerciseSkip
description: The number of periods in the referenced date schedule that are between each date in the relative date schedule. Thus a skip of 2 would mean that dates are relative to every second date in the referenced schedule. If present this should have a value greater than 1.

name: LegOptionExerciseNominationDeadline
description: The last date (adjusted) for establishing the option exercise terms.

name: LegOptionExerciseFirstDateUnadjusted
description: The unadjusted first exercise date.

name: LegOptionExerciseLastDateUnadjusted
description: The unadjusted last exercise date.

name: LegOptionExerciseEarliestTime
description: The earliest time at which notice of exercise can be given by the buyer to the seller (or seller's agent) (i) on the expriation date, in the case of a European style option, (ii) on each Bermuda option exercise date and the expiration date, in the case of a Bermuda style option, (iii) the commencement date to, and including, the expiration date, in the case of an American option.

name: LegOptionExerciseLatestTime
description: The latest exercise time. See also LegOptionExerciseEarliestTime(41509).

name: LegOptionExerciseTimeBusinessCenter
description:
The business center used to determine the locale for option exercise time, e.g. "GBLO".
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

name: NoLegOptionExerciseDates
description: Number of dates in the repeating group.

name: LegOptionExerciseDate
description: The adjusted or unadjusted option exercise fixed date.

name: LegOptionExerciseDateType
description: Specifies the type of option exercise date. When specified it applies not only to the current date but to all subsequent dates in the group until overridden with a new type.

name: NoLegOptionExerciseExpirationDateBusinessCenters
description: Number of business centers in the repeating group.

name: LegOptionExerciseExpirationDateBusinessCenter
description:
The business center calendar used to adjust the option exercise expiration dates, e.g. "GBLO".
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

name: LegOptionExerciseExpirationDateBusinessDayConvention
description: The business day convention used to adjust the option exercise expiration dates. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the LegDateAdjustment component within the InstrumentLeg component.

name: LegOptionExerciseExpirationDateRelativeTo
description:
Specifies the anchor date when the option exercise expiration date is relative to an anchor date.
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/relative-to-date for values.

name: LegOptionExerciseExpirationDateOffsetPeriod
description: Time unit multiplier for the relative exercise expiration date offset.

name: LegOptionExerciseExpirationDateOffsetUnit
description: Time unit associated with the relative exercise expiration date offset.

name: LegOptionExerciseExpirationFrequencyPeriod
description: Time unit multiplier for the frequency of exercise expiration dates.

name: LegOptionExerciseExpirationFrequencyUnit
description: Time unit associated with the frequency of exercise expiration dates.

name: LegOptionExerciseExpirationRollConvention
description: The convention for determining the sequence of exercise expiration dates. It is used in conjunction with a specified frequency. Used only to override the roll convention defined in the LegDateAdjustment component in InstrumentLeg.

values.meaning: The floating rate note convention or Eurodollar convention.
The International Money Market settlement date, i.e. the 3rd Wednesday of the month.
The last trading day/expiration day of the Canadian Derivatives Exchange.
The last trading day of the Sydney Futures Exchange Australian 90-day bank accepted bill futures contract.
The last trading day of the Sydney Futures Exchange New Zealand 90-day bank bill futures contract.
The Sydney Futures Exchange 90-day bank accepted bill futures settlement dates.
The 13-week and 26-week U.S. Treasury Bill auction dates.

name: LegOptionExerciseExpirationDateOffsetDayType
description: Specifies the day type of the relative option exercise expiration date offset.

name: LegOptionExerciseExpirationTime
description: The option exercise expiration time.

name: LegOptionExerciseExpirationTimeBusinessCenter
description:
The business center used to determine the locale for option exercise expiration time, e.g. "GBLO".
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

name: NoLegOptionExerciseExpirationDates
description: Number of fixed exercise expiration dates in the repeating group.

name: LegOptionExerciseExpirationDate
description: The adjusted or unadjusted option exercise expiration fixed date.

name: LegOptionExerciseExpirationDateType
description: Specifies the type of option exercise expiration date. When specified it applies not only to the current date but to all subsequent dates in the group until overridden with a new type.

name: NoLegPaymentScheduleFixingDays
description: Number of fixing days in the repeating group.

name: LegPaymentScheduleFixingDayOfWeek
description: The day of the week on which fixing takes place.

values.meaning: Every day (the default if not specified)

name: LegPaymentScheduleFixingDayNumber
description: The occurrence of the day of week on which fixing takes place.

name: LegPaymentScheduleXID
description: Identifier of this LegPaymentSchedule for cross referencing elsewhere in the message.

name: LegPaymentScheduleXIDRef
description: Reference to payment schedule elsewhere in the message.

name: LegPaymentScheduleRateCurrency
description: The currency of the schedule rate. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

name: LegPaymentScheduleRateUnitOfMeasure
description: The schedule rate unit of measure (UOM).

values.meaning: Principal with relation to debt instrument

name: LegPaymentScheduleRateConversionFactor
description: The number multipled by the derived floating rate of the leg's payment schedule in order to arrive at the payment rate. If omitted, the schedule rate conversion factor is 1.

name: LegPaymentScheduleRateSpreadType
description: Identifies whether the rate spread is an absolute value to be added to the index rate or a percentage of the index rate.

name: LegPaymentScheduleSettlPeriodPrice
description: The schedule settlement period price.

name: LegPaymentScheduleSettlPeriodPriceCurrency
description: The currency of the schedule settlement period price. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

name: LegPaymentScheduleSettlPeriodPriceUnitOfMeasure
description: The settlement period price unit of measure (UOM).

values.meaning: Principal with relation to debt instrument

name: LegPaymentScheduleStepUnitOfMeasure
description: The schedule step unit of measure (UOM).

values.meaning: Principal with relation to debt instrument

name: LegPaymentScheduleFixingDayDistribution
description: The distribution of fixing days.

name: LegPaymentScheduleFixingDayCount
description: The number of days over which fixing should take place.

name: LegPaymentScheduleFixingLagPeriod
description: Time unit multiplier for the fixing lag duration.

name: LegPaymentScheduleFixingLagUnit
description: Time unit associated with the fixing lag duration.

name: LegPaymentScheduleFixingFirstObservationDateOffsetPeriod
description: Time unit multiplier for the relative first observation date offset.

name: LegPaymentScheduleFixingFirstObservationDateOffsetUnit
description: Time unit associated with the relative first observation date offset.

name: LegPaymentStreamFlatRateIndicator
description: When this element is specified and set to 'Y', the Flat Rate is the New Worldwide Tanker Nominal Freight Scale for the Freight Index Route taken at the trade date of the transaction "Fixed". If 'N' it is taken on each pricing date "Floating".

name: LegPaymentStreamFlatRateAmount
description: Specifies the actual monetary value of the flat rate when LegPaymentStreamFlatRateIndicator(41549) = 'Y'.

name: LegPaymentStreamFlatRateCurrency
description: Specifies the currency of the actual flat rate. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

name: LegStreamMaximumPaymentAmount
description: Specifies the limit on the total payment amount.

name: LegStreamMaximumPaymentCurrency
description: Specifies the currency of total payment amount limit. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

name: LegStreamMaximumTransactionAmount
description: Specifies the limit on the payment amount that goes out in any particular calculation period.

name: LegStreamMaximumTransactionCurrency
description: Specifies the currency of the period payment amount limit. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

name: LegPaymentStreamFixedAmountUnitOfMeasure
description: The fixed payment amount unit of measure (UOM).

values.meaning: Principal with relation to debt instrument

name: LegPaymentStreamTotalFixedAmount
description: Specifies the total fixed payment amount.

name: LegPaymentStreamWorldScaleRate
description: The number of Worldscale points for purposes of the calculation of a fixed amount for a wet voyage charter commodity swap.

name: LegPaymentStreamContractPrice
description: The price per relevant unit for purposes of the calculation of a fixed amount for a dry voyage charter or time charter commodity swap.

name: LegPaymentStreamContractPriceCurrency
description: Specifies the currency of LegPaymentStreamContractPrice(41559). Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

name: NoLegPaymentStreamPricingBusinessCenters
description: Number of business centers in the repeating group.

name: LegPaymentStreamPricingBusinessCenter
description:
The business center calendar used to adjust the pricing dates, e.g. "GBLO".
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

name: LegPaymentStreamRateIndex2CurveUnit
description: Secondary time unit associated with the payment stream's floating rate index curve.

name: LegPaymentStreamRateIndex2CurvePeriod
description: Secondary time unit multiplier for the payment stream's floating rate index curve.

name: LegPaymentStreamRateIndexLocation
description: Specifies the location of the floating rate index.

name: LegPaymentStreamRateIndexLevel
description: This is the weather Cooling Degree Days (CDD), Heating Degree Days (HDD) or HDD index level specified as the number of (amount of) weather index units specified by the parties in the related confirmation.

name: LegPaymentStreamRateIndexUnitOfMeasure
description: The unit of measure (UOM) of the rate index level.

values.meaning: Principal with relation to debt instrument

name: LegPaymentStreamSettlLevel
description: Specifies how weather index units are to be calculated.

name: LegPaymentStreamReferenceLevel
description: This is the weather Cooling Degree Days (CDD), Heating Degree Days (HDD) or HDD reference level specified as the number of (amount of) weather index units specified by the parties in the related confirmation.

name: LegPaymentStreamReferenceLevelUnitOfMeasure
description: The unit of measure (UOM) of the rate reference level.

values.meaning: Principal with relation to debt instrument

name: LegPaymentStreamReferenceLevelEqualsZeroIndicator
description: When set to 'Y', it indicates that the weather reference level equals zero.

name: LegPaymentStreamRateSpreadCurrency
description: Specifies the currency of the floating rate spread. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

name: LegPaymentStreamRateSpreadUnitOfMeasure
description: Specifies the unit of measure (UOM) of the floating rate spread.

values.meaning: Principal with relation to debt instrument

name: LegPaymentStreamRateConversionFactor
description: The number to be multiplied by the derived floating rate of the leg's payment stream in order to arrive at the payment rate. If omitted, the floating rate conversion factor is 1.

name: LegPaymentStreamRateSpreadType
description: Identifies whether the rate spread is an absolute value to be added to the index rate or a percentage of the index rate.

name: LegPaymentStreamLastResetRate
description: The floating rate determined at the most recent reset. The rate is expressed in decimal form, e.g. 5% is represented as 0.05.

name: LegPaymentStreamFinalRate
description: The floating rate determined at the final reset. The rate is expressed in decimal form, e.g. 5% is represented as 0.05.

name: LegPaymentStreamCalculationLagPeriod
description: Time unit multiplier for the calculation lag duration.

name: LegPaymentStreamCalculationLagUnit
description: Time unit associated with the calculation lag duration.

name: LegPaymentStreamFirstObservationDateOffsetPeriod
description: Time unit multiplier for the relative first observation date offset.

name: LegPaymentStreamFirstObservationDateOffsetUnit
description: Time unit associated with the relative first observation date offset.

name: LegPaymentStreamPricingDayType
description: Specifies the commodity pricing day type.

name: LegPaymentStreamPricingDayDistribution
description: The distribution of pricing days.

name: LegPaymentStreamPricingDayCount
description: The number of days over which pricing should take place.

name: LegPaymentStreamPricingBusinessCalendar
description:
Specifies the business calendar to use for pricing.
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/commodity-business-calendar for values.

name: LegPaymentStreamPricingBusinessDayConvention
description: The business day convention used to adjust the payment stream's pricing dates. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the LegDateAdjustment component within the InstrumentLeg component.

name: UnderlyingDeliveryStreamRiskApportionmentSource
description:
Specifies the source or legal framework for the risk apportionment.
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/risk-apportionment-source for the details of the external code list.

name: StreamCommoditySettlTimeType
description: Specifies the format of the commodities settlement start and end times.

name: NoLegPaymentStreamPaymentDates
description: Number of payment dates in the repeating group.

name: LegPaymentStreamPaymentDate
description: The adjusted or unadjusted fixed stream payment date.

name: LegPaymentStreamPaymentDateType
description: Specifies the type of payment date. When specified it applies not only to the current date but to all subsequent dates in the group until overridden with a new type.

name: LegPaymentStreamMasterAgreementPaymentDatesIndicator
description: When set to 'Y', it indicates that payment dates are specified in the relevant master agreement.

name: NoLegPaymentStreamPricingDates
description: Number of pricing dates in the repeating group.

name: LegPaymentStreamPricingDate
description: The adjusted or unadusted fixed stream pricing date.

name: LegPaymentStreamPricingDateType
description: Specifies the type of pricing date. When specified it applies not only to the current date but to all subsequent dates in the group until overridden with a new type.

name: NoLegPaymentStreamPricingDays
description: Number of pricing days in the repeating group.

name: LegPaymentStreamPricingDayOfWeek
description: The day of the week on which pricing takes place.

values.meaning: Every day (the default if not specified)

name: LegPaymentStreamPricingDayNumber
description: The occurrence of the day of week on which pricing takes place.

name: NoLegPhysicalSettlTerms
description: Number of entries in the repeating group.

name: LegPhysicalSettlTermXID
description: A named string value referenced by UnderlyingSettlTermXIDRef(41315).

name: LegPhysicalSettlCurency
description: Specifies the currency of physical settlement. Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

name: LegPhysicalSettlBusinessDays
description: The number of business days used in the determination of physical settlement. Its precise meaning depends on the context in which this is used.

name: LegPhysicalSettlMaximumBusinessDays
description: A maximum number of business days. Its precise meaning depends on the context in which this element is used. Intended to be used to limit a particular ISDA fallback provision.

name: NoLegPhysicalSettlDeliverableObligations
description: Number of entries in the repeating group.

name: LegPhysicalSettlDeliverableObligationType
description: Specifies the type of delivery obligation applicable for physical settlement.

name: LegPhysicalSettlDeliverableObligationValue
description:
Physical settlement delivery obligation value appropriate to LegPhysicalSettlDeliverableObligationType(41605).
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/deliverable-obligation-type for code list for applicable deliverable obligation types.

name: NoLegPricingDateBusinessCenters
description: Number of business centers in the repeating group.

name: LegPricingDateBusinessCenter
description:
The business center calendar used to adjust the pricing or fixing date, e.g. "GBLO".
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

name: LegPricingDateUnadjusted
description: The unadjusted pricing or fixing date.

name: LegPricingDateBusinessDayConvention
description: The business day convention used to adjust the pricing or fixing date. Used only to override the business day convention specified in the LegDateAdjustment component within the InstrumentLeg component.

name: LegPricingDateAdjusted
description: The adjusted pricing or fixing date.

name: LegPricingTime
description: The local market pricing or fixing time.

name: LegPricingTimeBusinessCenter
description: Specifies the business center for determining the pricing or fixing time. See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

name: NoLegProtectionTermEventNewsSources
description: Number of event sources in the repeating group.

name: LegProtectionTermEventNewsSource
description: A newspaper or electronic news service that may publish relevant information used in the determination of whether or not a credit event has occurred.

name: NoLegProtectionTerms
description: Number of protection terms in the repeating group.

name: LegProtectionTermXID
description: A named string value referenced from UnderlyingProtectionTermXIDRef(41314).

name: LegProtectionTermNotional
description: The notional amount of protection coverage.

name: LegProtectionTermCurrency
description: The currency of LegProtectionTermNotional(41618). Uses ISO 4217 currency codes.

name: LegProtectionTermSellerNotifies
description: The notifying party is the party that notifies the other party when a credit event has occurred by means of a credit event notice. If more than one party is referenced as being the notifying party then either party may notify the other of a credit event occurring. LegProtectionTermSellerNotifies(41620)=Y indicates that the seller notifies.

name: LegProtectionTermBuyerNotifies
description: The notifying party is the party that notifies the other party when a credit event has occurred by means of a credit event notice. If more than one party is referenced as being the notifying party then either party may notify the other of a credit event occurring. LegProtectionTermBuyerNotifies(41621)=Y indicates that the buyer notifies.

name: LegProtectionTermEventBusinessCenter
description:
When used, the business center indicates the local time of the business center that replaces the Greenwich Mean Time in Section 3.3 of the 2003 ISDA Credit Derivatives Definitions.
See https://fpml.org/coding-scheme/business-center for standard 4-character code values.

name: LegProtectionTermStandardSources
description: Indicates whether ISDA defined Standard Public Sources are applicable (LegProtectionTermStandardSources(41623)=Y) or not.

name: LegProtectionTermEventMinimumSources
description: The minimum number of the specified public information sources that must publish information that reasonably confirms that a credit event has occurred. The market convention is two.

name: NoLegProtectionTermEvents
description: Number of protection term events in the repeating group.

name: LegProtectionTermEventType
description:
Specifies the type of credit event applicable to the protection terms.
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/protection-term-event-type for code list of applicable event types.

name: LegProtectionTermEventValue
description:
Specifies the protection term event value appropriate to LegProtectionTermEventType(41626).
See https://fixtrading.org/packages/protection-term-event-type/protection-term-event-type for applicable event type values.
